$comment: Authoritative inventory of Musi harness controls. Re-generate the agent-facing markdown with `bun run docs:harness-controls`; validate against reality with `bun run harness:check`. For `kind: lint-rule` entries, the per-rule `category`, `principle`, `pairedGuide`, `repairKind`, and `repairCommand` are re-projected by the generator from the rule's own `meta.docs` (PR 1 contract) — keep them out of the manifest so there is one source of truth.

controls.principle: Block oversized staged blobs from entering git history; large blobs balloon clone time and are usually accidental commits of generated artifacts.
Detect workspace-unused files, exports, types, and dependencies so dead code does not accumulate behind import-graph blind spots.
Prevent knip-reported unused exported symbols from growing above the committed baseline while raw knip dependency/file and duplication reports remain advisory.
Report per-worktree database, port, Redis, and SRD seed drift so secondary worktrees stay reproducible and isolated.
Report migration, Prisma client, and database connectivity drift so the runtime contract between schema and code stays observable.
Flag destructive or risky Prisma migrations that lack an explicit acknowledgement entry; intentional destructive migrations must be opt-in.

Read-only fusion of HarnessDiagnostics envelope files (lint:ratchet, drift:ai, logs:audit) into one report grouped by tool, with totals and per-control counts; an artifact generator for scheduled or manual review, not an edit-loop gate — findings never gate, only unreadable or malformed envelopes exit non-zero.

Run lint, lint:ratchet, the zero-baseline lifecycle check, the knip unused-export floor, coverage-map, format check, typecheck, test, and script smoke suites against the full tree with shared cache, lock, and log directory so a failing slot leaves the rest reusable; lint preflights packages/{shared,server}/dist and runs typecheck automatically before ESLint when those ignored outputs are missing.

Run lint:changed, lint:ratchet, the zero-baseline lifecycle check, the knip unused-export floor, coverage-map, format:changed:check, typecheck, test:changed, and test:scripts:changed in parallel against the changed-file set; default edit-loop gate before commit; when packages/{shared,server}/dist is missing, the wrapper defers lint until the existing typecheck slot has produced those ignored outputs.

slots.name: scripts
slots.condition: when changed hook/script/harness inputs require script smoke

controls.principle: Run the full lint, ratchet, zero-baseline lifecycle check, knip unused-export floor, coverage-map, format check, typecheck, test, and scripts suites in parallel; reduces full-verify wall time when the full script suite fits the selected timeout or cached state; when packages/{shared,server}/dist is missing, the wrapper defers lint until the existing typecheck slot has produced those ignored outputs.
Run the full verify suite followed by the slow vitest project; used to opt in to gated slow tests when verifying schema or rules-engine changes.
Surface cached verify logs without copying paths; supports budget and slow-test analysis so failures discovered in a prior run stay visible.
Surface recent persisted verify and pre-commit run metadata snapshots so slow-run performance evidence survives the latest-log wipe.
Run verify in the background with status/tail/stop sub-commands so an agent can keep editing while a long verify is in flight.

Aggregated read-only diagnostic: composes worktree:status, db:status, env-file sanity, port binding, dependency freshness, yamllint and ShellCheck system-tool availability, the lint host-tool inventory, lint-ratchet merge-driver health, suppression registers, migration safety, drift:ai harness-freshness, knip, and blob-size; report-only — exits non-zero only on FAIL counts.

Validate that .devcontainer/.env, per-worktree .env, and packages/client/.env carry the keys required for DB, Redis, and JWT auth so a misconfigured worktree fails loudly at doctor time, not at request time.
Report whether the worktree's server and client ports are bound; a bound port is almost always the contributor's own dev server, but the report disambiguates so a stuck process is visible.
Compare the bun install marker mtime against bun.lock so a stale node_modules — typically after a branch switch — is flagged before it manifests as a missing or wrong-version dependency.

Compare packages/shared/src mtimes against the compiled @musi/shared dist that tests import through the package exports map, so a missing or stale dist — typically after a branch switch or fresh clone — is flagged before it surfaces as dozens of phantom '<X> is not a function' test failures.

Compare schema.prisma against the generated Prisma client mtime so a stale or ungenerated client — typically after a branch switch or fresh clone — is flagged before it surfaces as confusing import-time test failures.
Report whether yamllint is available from the system PATH; config-sensor lint requires the apt-provided yamllint package rather than a repo-local Python venv.
Report whether ShellCheck is available from the system PATH; shell lint requires the apt-provided shellcheck package rather than the npm wrapper.

Report presence, resolved path, installed version, and known-good version for the host tools the lint surface invokes (eslint, prettier, taplo, node-actionlint, hadolint, bun), reading each known-good version from its single source; report-first, never installs.

Verify the clone-local lint-ratchet baseline merge driver config, installed driver copy, and info-attributes mirror are present and current so baseline merges do not silently fall back to textual JSON conflict markers.
Scan for new eslint-disable comments missing a `-- reason` text or for broad disables outside the file/rule allowlist; suppressions must be self-documenting.
Scan for current-state TypeScript and Stryker suppressions missing `-- reason`, deprecated `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-nocheck` outside the allowlist, or broad Stryker disables; report-only baseline.

Default AI-drift scope: scan changed files for copy/paste duplicates, suspicious sibling modules, over-narrated comments, and newly added suppression comments; report-only unless --fail-on-findings is passed.
Whole-repo AI-drift scope: audit the current source inventory with the default AI-drift checks; suppressions is diff-only and skips with a reason.
Report advisory git-history hotspots across churn, coupling, fragmentation, suppression-churn, and thrash lenses; areas to inspect, not defects.
Report advisory git-history coldspots across coldspot and stale-marker lenses; areas to inspect, not defects.
Detect docs/ai-harness.md inventory drift: unreferenced docs/guides/*.md, missing referenced guides, and stale backtick repo paths.
Inspect the effective drift:ai config for the target repo: config source, repo root, roots, source extensions, and the default/implemented check sets; read-only and never rewrites a config file.
Report Playwright locator-usage patterns across e2e tests so raw-locator regressions stay visible after the selector ratchets retired.

Generate the agent-facing harness controls map from harness.controls.json (lint-rule entries re-projected from each rule's meta.docs); --check fails on drift between the manifest and the generated markdown.
Generate the agent-facing local lint rule guide from each rule's meta.docs contract; --check fails on drift between the generated markdown and the rule set.
Generate MODULE-INDEX.md from discovered MODULE.md files; --check fails on drift so orphaned or missing module docs surface in CI.

Emit a schema-validated harness diagnostics envelope for `local/*` ESLint findings, parser errors, and info disclosures for skipped non-local ESLint findings; this is a local-rule view, not full lint parity.
Represent non-local ESLint findings omitted from the local-rule diagnostics projection as info-severity envelope entries so consumers can see that the artifact is intentionally partial.
Generate Claude and Codex hook wiring from harness.controls.json; --check fails on drift between the manifest and checked-in adapter configs.
Generate verify wrapper slot arrays from harness.controls.json; --check fails on drift between the manifest and checked-in shell metadata.
Scope the local-rule diagnostics envelope to changed JS/TS-like files while preserving the `local/*` and parser-error contract; this is not `lint:changed` parity.
Detect drift between the Leaf 41 lint coverage map and tracked repository paths, cited ratchet IDs, and status vocabulary so the hand-maintained inventory stays load-bearing.
Fail when drained lint ratchets are not documented with a zero-baseline lifecycle disposition, while still reporting normal ESLint promotion status.
Fail when a changed lint-ratchet baseline increases recorded debt unless the same range is recorded in the debt log, so hand-edited baselines cannot hide regressions.
Run ShellCheck over maintained shell scripts and hooks so shell bug classes are covered by the normal lint floor.
Run actionlint, yamllint, taplo, and hadolint over maintained workflow and config files so non-ESLint config surfaces stay covered by the normal lint floor.
Always-run lint lane holding runtime import cycles at zero via drift:ai import-cycles with --fail-on-runtime-cycles; type-only cycles stay report-only evidence and a skipped check fails closed.
Opt-in drift:ai comment-block sensor for likely tombstoned commented-out code; report-only and gated by configured minimum block length.
Opt-in drift:ai path-freshness check for backtick file references in MODULE.md and *-MODULE.md docs; resolves references under configured roots.
Opt-in drift:ai knip adapter for never-imported files; findings use the target's knip config and carry target-config provenance.
Opt-in drift:ai knip adapter for duplicate export aliases; findings use the target's knip config and carry target-config provenance.
Opt-in drift:ai TypeScript graph check for circular imports, including labeled type-only cycles; uses the target tsconfig or --tsconfig override.
Opt-in drift:ai server layer-direction check for reverse imports across configured layers; findings carry drift-baseline provenance.
Opt-in drift:ai AST-similarity check for same-shaped function clones that exact duplicate detection misses; findings carry drift-baseline provenance.
Opt-in drift:ai structural duplicate check for identical interface or object type property bags across files; findings carry drift-baseline provenance.
Opt-in drift:ai structural duplicate check for z.object schemas with matching key sets across files; findings carry drift-baseline provenance.
Opt-in drift:ai structural duplicate check for repeated string or numeric literals across multiple files; findings carry drift-baseline provenance.
Opt-in drift:ai structural duplicate check for module-level constants initialized to the same literal value across files; findings carry drift-baseline provenance.
Opt-in drift:ai knip adapter for unused exported symbols, types, enum members, and namespace members; findings use the target's knip config and carry target-config provenance.
Detect runtime log records whose event fields are missing or unstable, so log consumers can group behavior without parsing free-form messages.
Detect selected log files that cannot be read, so automation distinguishes missing inputs from clean log quality.
Detect malformed JSONL records and empty log lines before downstream diagnostics consume runtime logs.
Detect obvious unredacted sensitive fields in runtime logs so verification artifacts do not leak credentials or private tokens.
Detect runtime log records with missing or inconsistent request ids so request-scoped behavior remains traceable.
Rewrite direct Prisma writes on concurrency-gated delegates to documented helper boundaries; name-based, so aliases and destructured handles still need manual review.
Expand index.ts barrel re-exports into direct imports at every call site so tree-shaking and dependency graphs stay legible.
Convert console.* calls to structured pino logger calls with the dynamic value lifted into the metadata object so log aggregation can group identical messages.
Migrate inline tRPC router input schemas to imports from @musi/shared/schemas so the client/server contract has one source of truth.
Migrate inline tRPC router output schemas to imports from @musi/shared/schemas so the client/server contract has one source of truth.

Run lint:changed, lint:ratchet, the zero-baseline lifecycle check, the knip unused-export floor, coverage-map, format:changed:check, typecheck, test:changed, and conditionally test:scripts:changed in parallel before allowing the commit; when packages/{shared,server}/dist is missing, defer lint until the existing typecheck slot has produced those ignored outputs.

slots.name: scripts
slots.condition: when staged hook/script/harness inputs require script smoke

controls.principle: When pushed commits were created under fast-commit mode, require fresh full-verify metadata matching the pushed HEAD before allowing git push, so cheap local commits still have a local full-verify backstop before publication.
Finalize fast-commit provenance after Git creates a commit SHA, allowing pre-push to identify commits made while fast-commit mode skipped slow pre-commit slots.
Enforce conventional-commit shape on the commit message: type(scope) subject >= 20 chars, body >= 40 chars excluding trailers; merge/revert/fixup/squash exempt.
Refresh worktree state after a branch switch so the secondary worktree's per-branch caches and node_modules stay coherent.
Refresh worktree state after a merge so dependency, Prisma client, and module-index drift caused by the merge is visible before the next edit.

Block Claude Bash calls that bypass the safety harness (no --no-verify, no force-push to main, no direct psql/redis-cli/docker against shared infra) so destructive ops stay opt-in; Codex gets the same policy surface through its Bash aggregator.

notes.codex: Codex deliberately uses .codex/hooks/pre-tool-use.sh as a Bash aggregator for the same policy surface.
notes.copilot: Copilot deliberately gets the same policy surface through .copilot/hooks/pre-tool-use.sh, its Bash aggregator.

controls.principle: Aggregate Codex Bash PreToolUse policy, quiet-run cache checks, and commit state capture in the single Codex Bash hook surface.

notes.claude: Claude deliberately uses direct Bash PreToolUse adapters because it does not have Codex's Bash aggregator model.
notes.copilot: Copilot runs the same shared Bash aggregate body through hook/ai-copilot-pre-tool-use.

controls.principle: Aggregate Copilot Bash preToolUse policy, quiet-run cache checks, and commit state capture in the single Copilot Bash hook surface; the adapter normalizes Copilot payloads before the shared aggregate body runs.

notes.claude: Claude deliberately uses direct Bash PreToolUse adapters because it does not have Copilot's aggregator model.
notes.codex: Codex runs the same shared Bash aggregate body through hook/ai-codex-pre-tool-use.

controls.principle: Capture Claude git commit state and summarize pre-commit or commit output so the interactive transcript shows the actionable result without streaming the full hook log.

notes.codex: Codex deliberately handles commit state and summaries inside its PreToolUse/PostToolUse Bash aggregators.
notes.copilot: Copilot deliberately handles commit state and summaries inside its PreToolUse/PostToolUse Bash aggregators, mirroring Codex.

controls.principle: Short-circuit repeated Claude `bun run` commands through the AI hook cache and summarize prior failures so routine verification stays readable.

notes.codex: Codex deliberately handles `bun run` cache and quieting inside .codex/hooks/pre-tool-use.sh.
notes.copilot: Copilot deliberately handles `bun run` cache checks and output quieting inside its Bash aggregators, mirroring Codex.

controls.principle: Advise on guide-worthy AI edits and deny hand edits to generated, lockfile, ratchet-baseline, suppression-register, and Husky-internal surfaces unless the repo-wide .allow-protected-edits marker loudly downgrades the denial for deliberate maintenance.
controls.invocation: Claude PreToolUse / Codex PreToolUse / Copilot preToolUse hook

controls.principle: After an AI Edit/Write to packages/server/prisma/schema.prisma, warn if `bun run --filter @musi/server prisma:generate` has not been re-run so the generated client stays in sync with the schema.
controls.invocation: Claude PostToolUse / Codex PostToolUse / Copilot postToolUse hook

controls.principle: Advise when always-loaded agent context files grow past their length budget during AI edits, and warn at pre-commit when canonical agent docs or working notes exceed their budget.
controls.invocation: Claude PostToolUse / Codex PostToolUse / Copilot postToolUse hook

controls.principle: Run the shared edited-file tidy hook after AI file edits so formatter-friendly files are normalized immediately; warn-level lint leftovers are deferred to the Stop hook.
controls.invocation: Claude PostToolUse / Codex PostToolUse / Copilot postToolUse hook

controls.principle: After AI edits, advise when changed TypeScript surfaces lack an expected lint coverage-map row so new script and code surfaces do not silently escape lint policy.
controls.invocation: Claude PostToolUse / Codex PostToolUse / Copilot postToolUse hook

controls.principle: After AI edits, run the targeted lint-ratchet advisory surface so fresh regressions are visible before the next verify or commit gate.
controls.invocation: Claude PostToolUse / Codex PostToolUse / Copilot postToolUse hook

controls.principle: Aggregate Codex Bash PostToolUse commit-result summaries after persistence so commit success, hook failures, and uncertain commit states are surfaced concisely.

notes.claude: Claude deliberately keeps commit output handling in its git-commit-quiet adapter instead of using a Bash PostToolUse aggregator.
notes.copilot: Copilot runs the same shared Bash aggregate body through hook/ai-copilot-post-tool-use.

controls.principle: Summarize Copilot Bash tool output after commits and wrapped bun runs in the single Copilot Bash hook surface; the adapter normalizes Copilot payloads before the shared aggregate body runs.

notes.claude: Claude deliberately keeps commit output handling in its git-commit-quiet adapter instead of using a Bash PostToolUse aggregator.
notes.codex: Codex runs the same shared Bash aggregate body through hook/ai-codex-post-tool-use.

controls.principle: After a Claude Bash failure, inject bounded guidance for documented high-frequency failures: ESLint heap OOMs, observed flaky tests, and verification lock contention.

notes.codex: Codex has no PostToolUseFailure hook event.
notes.copilot: Copilot has no PostToolUseFailure hook event.

controls.principle: After context compaction, re-inject a bounded repository state snapshot so branch, dirty-tree, fast-commit, kill-switch, and cached verification state survive in the fresh context window.

notes.codex: Codex compact hooks do not support additionalContext re-injection; omitted until a Codex-valid context-injection contract exists.
notes.copilot: Copilot has no SessionStart hook event.

controls.principle: Run a scoped-down stop policy at subagent completion so delegated work sees dirty-tree and cached verification nudges without consuming the main session's stop reminder state.

notes.codex: Codex SubagentStop does not support additionalContext re-injection; omitted until a Codex-valid advisory contract exists.
notes.copilot: Copilot has no SubagentStop hook event.

controls.principle: Run the shared stop reminder at session stop so pending verification, stale generated files, changed-file lint warnings, or unresolved policy reminders are surfaced before handoff; a per-worktree musi-stop-hard marker makes dirty-tree and cached-verify failures persistently blocking.
controls.invocation: Claude Stop / Codex Stop / Copilot agentStop hook
